observation: The circular correction looked smooth, but its authored radial loops used 32 vertices.
root_cause: Density was selected from a render-first habit instead of the minimum editable control-cage resolution required by Subdivision Surface.
decision: Reduce every authored radial loop to 16 vertices and let two SubD levels provide evaluated smoothness.
lesson: For this lens scale, 12-16 radial control vertices are sufficient; higher evaluated density belongs to SubD, not the editable cage.
